table netdev first {
	chain ingress {
		type filter hook ingress devices = { eth0, eth1 } priority -300; policy accept;
		tcp dport 22 accept
		tcp dport 80 jump web
	}

	chain web {
		iifname "eth1" return
		drop
	}
}
table inet second {
	chain ingress {
		type filter hook ingress device "eth0" priority filter; policy accept;
		tcp dport 22 drop
		tcp dport 8080 accept
	}
}
table netdev third {
	chain ingress {
		type filter hook ingress device "eth1" priority 100; policy accept;
		tcp dport 8080 drop
	}
}
